note: lap 12 pre-registration (template; lap 11's with the lap 12 requests and the flake rule). At gate main the requests the screen left out are deleted; entrance.ts resolves each set to its last redraft and fills approvedVersions at gate entrance, before any main build. Rules: docs/lap-12/runbook.md. Lines as lap 8. A request is at the ceiling when every set P >= ceilingPct, at the floor when every set P <= floorPct (raw or corrected): its verdicts are undecided. Each main build is rescored twice (judgements = 3); P leaves out the flakes in flakes.json (flakeRule). The verdict across requests needs at least minRequests requests in the rule. errors.json and flakes.json (after the runs) give the corrected figures.
errorsRule: Errors rule (lap 8, plus lap 12): an expected value that contradicts the request, or an amount, date or count that does not add up, is an expectation error; so is a ui check on a text or look the request does not fix (only texts the scenario entered or the request fixes may be checked); and a scenario whose ui action without an expect is followed by another action (fill / click) while the later steps depend on what that action changes is a wait error ('wait'). Each with a quote of the request; the whole scenario is left out.
flakeRule: Flake rule (lap 12): per build, compare the last 3 judgements on the same factory version (replicates/history/<build>.<k>.json and the current record; after a factory fix, rescore twice more and use the 3 after the fix). A (set, scenario, build) whose pass / fail differs among them is a flake: it is left out of that build's pass fraction for that set (numerator and denominator); the others use their (unchanged) verdict. Flakes are listed in flakes.json as {"<set>": {"<scenario id>": ["<build>", ...]}} and must match tally's 'Verdicts that changed across judgements'. A request whose flakes exceed maxFlakePct of its (set, scenario, build) cells gets no verdict (it does not enter the rule) and is reported before the next gate; a build left with no scenario of a set after the exclusions stops the count for that request.
